title: Home Depot Bulk Inventory by ZIP dataset record
description: One point-in-time product-by-store observation or explicit failure from the Home Depot Bulk Inventory by ZIP Actor.

status.description: SUCCESS is a useful price or inventory observation for the verified product/store context. Inspect individual nullable fields; it does not guarantee every optional field.

productInput.description: Product identifier or reference accepted from the input.

storeSkuNumber.description: Home Depot Store SKU when exposed.

productName.description: Product name returned by the storefront.

productUrl.description: Canonical or fallback Home Depot product URL.

zipCodeRequested.description: Five-digit US ZIP code requested in the input.

storeId.description: Home Depot store identifier for the checked location.

storeNameRaw.description: Store name as returned by the source.

storeAddress.description: Public business address for the checked store.

distanceMiles.description: Source-reported distance from the requested ZIP, in miles.

price.description: Storefront price observed for the checked context.

originalPrice.description: Original price when the storefront exposes one.

clearancePrice.description: Clearance price when the storefront exposes one.

bulkQuantityRequired.description: Minimum quantity required for the bulk price.

stockQuantity.description: Point-in-time digital inventory count when exposed. Null is not zero.

inStock.description: Digital in-stock signal for this observation.

availabilityType.description: Raw availability classification returned by the storefront.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason for a failed row; null on success.

errorMessage.description: Sanitized diagnostic for a failed row; null on success.

checkedAt.description: UTC timestamp for the point-in-time observation.
